summary: Computes and formats vehicle performance estimates (acceleration, top speed, cornering G) into the setup display buffers on the this object. Uses a small numeric-integration loop over BrakeTemperatureFadeModel for acceleration and top-speed estimates and sub_430750 for cornering, selecting metric (150 km/h bound, km/h units) or imperial (100 mph bound, mph units) presentation from the byte_7D0474 UI flag. Every label string is resolved through BinarySearchInStringTable into the shared byte_5EC4CC scratch buffer before being copied to a local 64-byte label. Called by ValidateVehicleConfigurationFile (00433ED0), ConfigObjectDestructor (00466A70), ShortComputation_6c40 (00466C40), and SubCallVirtualDispatch (0047D060).

local_names.v49: 64-byte buffer for the base name resolved from byte_5C3F6C
local_names.v50: 64-byte buffer for the second format element from aS_2 / aG
local_names.v45: speed bound in display units (150 or 100)
local_names.i: acceleration integration time accumulator (0.04 s steps)
local_names.v40: accumulated velocity for the acceleration estimate

operations.description: Resolve the vehicle base name: BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, byte_5C3F6C, byte_5EC4CC); on success copy the byte_5C3F6C string into the shared byte_5EC4CC scratch buffer, then copy it into the local v49 buffer.

Clear the three display slots starting at this+6950: StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck is applied to this+6950, +6950+128, +6950+256 with the off_5C3810 format (empty format string) to blank the estimation lines.

Unit-selection guard on byte_7D0474: when set, metric path (bound v8=150, v45=41.6666..., units resolved from off_5C3F68); otherwise imperial path (v8=100, v45=44.704, units from off_5C3F64). Both paths resolve their unit string into byte_5EC4CC via BinarySearchInStringTable and copy it to v48.
Resolve the aEstAccel label into byte_5EC4CC and copy to v47, then resolve the aS_2 format element into byte_5EC4CC and copy to v50.
Format the header line into this+6566 as "%s (0-%d %s)%s" with v47 (label), v8 (speed bound), v48 (units), v49 (vehicle base name).

Acceleration estimate: iterate velocity v40 in 0.04 m/s steps via BrakeTemperatureFadeModel(this, v40); break when velocity drops to <= 0; use the midpoint value v26 = fade(this, v40 + v25*0.02) to step by v42 = v26*0.04; when v40+v42 exceeds the v45 bound, format this+6950 as "%.2f %s" with the interpolated time and break.
Resolve the aEstTopSpeed label into byte_5EC4CC and copy to v47, then format this+6694 as "%s%s" with v47 and v49.
Top-speed estimate: advance the iterator j by 0.135 m/s while BrakeTemperatureFadeModel(this, j) stays above 0.0; j converges to the top speed.

Convert top speed to display units: v43 = j * 3.6 (m/s to km/h) when byte_7D0474 is set, otherwise v43 = j * 2.236936292054402 (m/s to mph); format this+7078 as "%d %s" with (int)v43 and the v48 units.
Cornering estimate: v44 = sub_430750(this, 75.0) produces the lateral force value for the cornering display.
Resolve the aEstCornering label into byte_5EC4CC and copy to v47, then resolve the aG label into byte_5EC4CC and copy to v50.
Format this+6822 as "%s%s" (cornering label + base name) and return the result of formatting this+7206 as "%.2f %s" with v44 * 0.1019367991845056 (g-force conversion) and the v50 units.
